title: 2007年考研英语一 Part B · 小标题匹配

sentences: Directions;
You are going to read a list of headings and a text about what parents are supposed to do to guide their children into adulthood.
Choose a heading from the list A—G that best fits the meaning of each numbered part of the text (41-45).
The first and last paragraphs of the text are not numbered.
There are two extra headings that you do not need to use.
Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1.
(10 points)
translations: 说明；
你将阅读一份标题列表和一篇关于父母应该做什么来引导孩子进入成年期的文章。
从列表A—G中选择一个最符合文中每个编号部分（41-45）含义的标题。
文章的第一段和最后一段没有编号。
有两个多余的标题你不需要使用。
在答题卡1上标记你的答案。

sentences: [A] Set a Good Example for Your Kids
translations: [A] 为孩子树立好榜样

sentences: [B] Build Your Kids’ Work Skills
translations: [B] 培养孩子的工作技能

sentences: [C] Place Time Limits on Leisure Activities
translations: [C] 对休闲活动设定时间限制

sentences: [D] Talk About the Future on a Regular Basis
translations: [D] 定期谈论未来

sentences: [E] Help Kids Develop Coping Strategies
translations: [E] 帮助孩子发展应对策略

sentences: [F] Help Your Kids Figure Out Who They Are
translations: [F] 帮助孩子认清自己是谁

sentences: [G] Build Your Kids’ Sense of Responsibility
translations: [G] 培养孩子的责任感

sentences: How Can a Parent Help?
translations: 父母如何提供帮助？

sentences: Mothers and fathers can do a lot to ensure a safe landing in early adulthood for their kids.

Even if a job’s starting salary seems too small to satisfy an emerging adult’s need for rapid content, the transition from school to work can be less of a setback if the start-up adult is ready for the move.
Here are a few measures, drawn from my book Ready or Not, Here Life Comes, that parents can take to prevent what I call “work-life unreadiness”:
translations: 父母可以做很多事情来确保孩子安全着陆于成年早期。
即使一份工作的起薪似乎太少，无法满足一个刚成年的年轻人对快速满足的需求，如果这个刚起步的成年人已经为这一转变做好了准备，那么从学校到工作的过渡就可以减少挫折。
以下是一些措施，摘自我的书《准备好了吗，生活来了》，父母可以采取这些措施来防止我所说的“工作-生活未准备好”：

sentences: You can start this process when they are 11 or 12.
Periodically review their emerging strengths and weaknesses with them and work together on any shortcomings, like difficulty in communicating well or collaborating.
Also, identify the kinds of interests they keep coming back to, as these offer clues to the careers that will fit them best.
translations: 你可以在他们11或12岁时开始这个过程。
定期与他们一起回顾他们正在显现的优势和劣势，并共同克服任何缺点，比如沟通或合作方面的困难。
此外，找出他们反复出现的兴趣类型，因为这些为最适合他们的职业提供了线索。

sentences: Kids need a range of authentic role models—as opposed to members of their clique, pop stars and vaunted athletes.
Have regular dinner-table discussions about people the family knows and how they got where they are.
Discuss the joys and downsides of your own career and encourage your kids to form some ideas about their own future.
When asked what they want to do, they should be discouraged from saying “I have no idea.”
They can change their minds 200 times, but having only a foggy view of the future is of little good.
translations: 孩子们需要一系列真实的榜样——而不是他们小圈子里的人、流行明星和受吹捧的运动员。
定期在餐桌上讨论家庭认识的人以及他们是如何取得现在的位置的。
讨论你自己职业的乐趣和不利之处，并鼓励孩子对自己的未来形成一些想法。
当被问及他们想做什么时，应该劝阻他们说“我不知道”。
他们可以改变主意200次，但对未来只有模糊的看法几乎没有好处。

sentences: Teachers are responsible for teaching kids how to learn; parents should be responsible for teaching them how to work.
Assign responsibilities around the house and make sure homework deadlines are met.
Encourage teenagers to take a part-time job.
Kids need plenty of practice delaying gratification and deploying effective organizational skills, such as managing time and setting priorities.
translations: 老师负责教孩子如何学习；父母应该负责教他们如何工作。
分配家务责任，并确保作业截止日期得到遵守。
鼓励青少年做兼职工作。
孩子们需要大量练习延迟满足和运用有效的组织技能，比如管理时间和设定优先事项。

sentences: Playing video games encourages immediate content.
And hours of watching TV shows with canned laughter only teaches kids to process information in a passive way.
At the same time, listening through earphones to the same monotonous beats for long stretches encourages kids to stay inside their bubble instead of pursuing other endeavors.
All these activities can prevent the growth of important communication and thinking skills and make it difficult for kids to develop the kind of sustained concentration they will need for most jobs.
translations: 玩电子游戏鼓励即时满足。
而花数小时观看带有罐头笑声的电视节目只会教孩子以被动的方式处理信息。
与此同时，长时间通过耳机听同样单调的节拍会鼓励孩子待在自己的泡沫里，而不是追求其他努力。
所有这些活动都可能阻碍重要的沟通和思维技能的发展，并使孩子难以培养大多数工作所需的持续专注力。

sentences: They should know how to deal with setbacks, stresses and feelings of inadequacy.
They should also learn how to solve problems and resolve conflicts, ways to brainstorm and think critically.
Discussions at home can help kids practice doing these things and help them apply these skills to everyday life situations.
translations: 他们应该知道如何应对挫折、压力和不足感。
他们还应该学习如何解决问题和化解冲突，以及头脑风暴和批判性思考的方法。
家庭讨论可以帮助孩子练习做这些事情，并帮助他们将这些技能应用到日常生活情境中。

sentences: What about the son or daughter who is grown but seems to be struggling and wandering aimlessly through early adulthood?
Parents still have a major role to play, but now it is more delicate.
They have to be careful not to come across as disappointed in their child.

They should exhibit strong interest and respect for whatever currently interests their fledging adult (as naive or ill conceived as it may seem) while becoming a partner in exploring options for the future.
Most of all, these new adults must feel that they are respected and supported by a family that appreciates them.
translations: 对于已经长大但似乎在成年早期挣扎并漫无目的地徘徊的儿子或女儿，该怎么办呢？
父母仍然可以发挥重要作用，但现在这更加微妙。
他们必须小心，不要显得对孩子失望。
他们应该对刚成年的孩子当前感兴趣的任何事情表现出强烈的兴趣和尊重（无论这看起来多么天真或考虑不周），同时成为探索未来选择的伙伴。
最重要的是，这些新成年人必须感到他们受到一个欣赏他们的家庭的尊重和支持。
